content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02083 At a send request of a signal group with ComTransferProperty TRIGGERED_- ON_CHANGE_WITHOUT_REPETITION assigned to an I-PDU with ComTxModeMode DIRECT or MIXED , the AUTOSAR COM module shall immediately (within the next main function at the latest) initiate one transmission of the assigned I-PDU, if at least one new sent group signal differs to the locally stored (last sent or init) in length or value.
